name: Virtual
description: This field identifies the type of virtual instruction offered by the school. Virtual instruction is instruction in which students and teachers are separated by time and/or location, and interaction occurs via computers and/or telecommunications technologies.. The field is coded as follows: · F = Exclusively Virtual – The school has no physical building where students meet with each other or with teachers, all instruction is virtual. · V = Primarily Virtual – The school focuses on a systematic program of virtual instruction but includes some physical meetings among students or with teachers. · C = Primarily Classroom – The school offers virtual courses but virtual instruction is not the primary means of instruction. · N = Not Virtual – The school does not offer any virtual instruction. · P = Partial Virtual – The school offers some, but not all, instruction through virtual instruction. Note: This value was retired and replaced with the Primarily Virtual and Primarily Classroom values beginning with the 2016–17 school year.

description: 化学键ID: 化学键的唯一标识符

name: atom1
description: 原子1 ID: 键连接的第一个原子ID，FK→atom

name: atom2
description: 原子2 ID: 键连接的第二个原子ID，FK→atom

name: Contains
description: 1个Moleculecontains1:N个Atom；1个Atomconstitutes1:1个Molecule；Molecule和Atom通过Molecule关联；1 molecule contains N atoms — atom.molecule_id → molecule.molecule_id

name: HasBond
description: 1个Moleculehas1:N个Bond；1个Bondbelongs to1:1个Molecule；Molecule和Bond通过Molecule关联；1 molecule contains N bonds — bond.molecule_id → molecule.molecule_id

name: Connects
description: 1个Bondconnects1:N个Atom；1个Atomparticipates in1:N个Bond；Bond和Atom通过Atom关联；1 bond connects 2 atoms via connected table — connected.atom_id → atom.atom_id AND connected.atom_id2 → atom.atom_id (UNION both ends to get all atoms in the bond)
